title: Missing authorization on first growth setter
root_cause: The first configuration setter lacks an authorization modifier.
attack_path: An arbitrary caller invokes setFirst to modify protected configuration.
impact: The first synthetic configuration value can be changed by any caller.
recommended_fix: Require the authorized configuration role on setFirst.
